[quote=hatorre;60159816][nation]-Chimor[/nation]

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Hatorre wishes to establish diplomatic and commercial relations with Chimor, a country north of the Vespurias. Hatorre, with its exports of oil and gold, as well as its agricultural and manufactured products, offers Chimor a major supplier for its industrial market. Hatorre also offers Chimor a Trade Agreement, whereby Hatorrean investment in mining and ports in Chimu territory will be permitted and beneficial to both countries.[/quote]
[i][/i]
In name of his most honourable venerable imperial majesty, the Sapa Chumun Caur, I, Kuraka Chán Waname and the chimú people  praise the Hatorre ministry as well as it people, we recognize the potential of such deal and embrace to accelerate the progress as well the workforce of the honourable empire, for the modernization of the mentioned sectors and a stable flux of manufactured and agriculture, mainly oil, resources for the Empire as well being a truly appreciated add of goods for the nation.
however, the following terms taht follow Chimor wish:
*While explore the national economic development, it must not affect negatively the environment in any way and the agreement should agree to protect national natural patronage.
*The exchanges must be fair and equally profitable for both nations.
*The investment in the mining and port industries to the local laws will be limited to ensure no heavy dependencies on the investments...
We believe with such simple terms, our both nations can and will a great partnership as model for all of Vespurias.
Sincerely, Kuraka Chán Waname, delegated to foreign affairs by the Emperor Chumun Caur.
